name: Shewbread Showbread
overview: The Shewbread, also called the Hallowed Bread, was a sacred ordinance in the tabernacle, commanded by God to be placed continually before Him on a specially made table of shittim wood overlaid with pure gold. The detailed instructions for the table and its vessels highlight the bread's consecrated status and its essential position within the tabernacle, situated on the north side opposite the candlestick. These provisions underscore the bread's perpetual presence as an offering to the Lord, prepared and maintained by the Levites as part of the tabernacle's holy furniture and worship practices.
